title: Nisswa Guides League
specs: Fish species include Walleye, Crappie, Bass, Panfish, Northern Pike, Musky
Fish on lakes including Gull Lake, Pelican Lake, The Whitefish Chain, Mille Lacs Lake, Leech Lake, Round Lake
Fishing license required, can be purchased at S&W Bait and Tackle or online at MN DNR website
Bring driver's license and social security number for license purchase
blurb: The Nisswa Guides League offers guided fishing trips on various lakes including Mille Lacs Lake, Leech Lake, Pelican Lake, and Gull Lake. Trips are family-friendly and include all necessary fishing gear and live bait. Guests meet at S&W Bait and Tackle before heading out on tournament quality boats.
extraNote: Add an extra person for $150 · Add a follow boat for $150 · Accept cash, check or credit cards · Meet at S&W Bait and Tackle, 371 location
